55 engagements

Investors can check an asset or a company when its model, its data room and its reporting share one source of truth.

Technology, digital and fintech account for 55 of the 650+ engagements in HAYKALAH’s archive census, 2004–2026. HAYKALAH builds the reporting, records and platforms that keep a structured asset or company on plan, and prepares assets for Sukuk and tokenization. We deliver in-house and with partners, including Cyber HAYKALAH, our cybersecurity venture, and we have built a platform company of our own.

Archive census counts are indicative.

What we do

  • AI reporting dashboards with live KPIs for investors, boards and operators.

  • ERP, CRM and workflow automation.

  • Data rooms and digital records with a full audit trail.

  • Investment-platform architecture for funds, Sukuk and tokenized offerings.

  • Tokenization readiness: proofing checklists and screening bands.

  • HOAM screening of fintech and fund opportunities.

  • Data protection by design under the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL).

How we create value

  • 01

    Innovation

    For a housing program, HAYKALAH prepared a Sukuk structure with an optional tokenized slice, covering the issuance framework, the model and the tokenization design (proposal).

  • 04

    Automation

    For three income-producing assets in Riyadh, HAYKALAH designed the data room and a 34-point proofing checklist ahead of Sukuk and tokenization (2025).

  • 06

    Commercialization

    AS3A, a platform matching flexible and part-time Saudi workers with employers, was built by HAYKALAH and is operating with signed client agreements.

Questions

How does HAYKALAH screen fintech opportunities?

With HOAM, the HAYKALAH Opportunity Assessment Matrix. In 2025–26 it was used to score 14 fintech and fund deals for a fintech fund platform. It is a screening tool, not investment advice.

What is a proofing checklist?

A list of the documents and data an asset must have in order before a Sukuk issue or tokenization. For three income-producing assets in Riyadh, HAYKALAH’s checklist had 34 points.

Is tokenization regulated?

Where the tokens are securities, issuing and dealing in them are regulated activities, executed through appropriately licensed partners.

Tell us what you need to measure, record or build. We can start under an NDA.
